PDF.js 6.4.299, from the official `pdfjs-dist` npm package.

Uses the minified legacy build and matching worker, CMaps, standard fonts,
WASM decoders and ICC profiles. Files are copied unchanged, except the two
build files are named `pdf.mjs` and `pdf.worker.mjs`.

Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Examples: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and the asset directories' license files.
